# InstaWear

> Print-on-demand clothing store for global events — Champions League, Rio Carnival, Oktoberfest, Halloween. Organic cotton, AI designs, delivery in 3–7 business days. Prices in USD.

## Catalog
Categories: T-Shirts, Hoodies, Accessories, Mugs. Events: festival, sport, concert, seasonal, birthday. Product pages live at `/produit/:id` (see sitemap.xml for the full list, regenerated at every build). Prices shown with deal countdowns when promotions are active. No account needed to browse or order as guest; tracking by order code (format ORD-YYYY-XXXXXX).

## Policies
- Shipping: printed on demand via Printful, 3–7 business days, free over threshold.
- Returns: 30 days for print defects; personalized items non-returnable unless defective.
- Contact: form at /contact (creates a support ticket) or bonjour@instawear.com, reply within 24h business days.

## API
No public API. For AI crawlers: respect robots.txt, use sitemap.xml.
